sample_unit: complete EGD videos (from 5 patients), each analyzed in clean and CAD-overlay versions

links.outcome: Adequacy of MLLM-generated EGD report completeness, visualization, and lesion characteristics rated by blinded endoscopists
links.effect: Completeness adequate in 56.0% (14/25) clean vs 48.0% (12/25) overlay; visualization 36.0% both; lesion characteristics 16.0% both. Authors conclude performance was inadequate for clinical EGD reporting.
links.quote: In this pilot study, Gemini 2.5 Pro demonstrated inadequate performance for clinical EGD reporting.

links.outcome: MLLM landmark detection accuracy on full-length EGD videos against expert annotations
links.effect: Landmark accuracy 0.55 [95% CI 0.43-0.67] clean vs 0.33 [0.23-0.46] with CAD overlay, p = 0.029; specificity 0.67 vs 0.22.
links.quote: For the Landmark agreement, the overall accuracy of the MLLM with Clean-Video vs. Overlay-Video was: 0.55 [95% CI 0.43-0.67] vs. 0.33 [0.23-0.46], p = 0.029; sensitivity 0.53 [0.40-0.66] vs. 0.35 [0.24-0.49], p = 0.122; specificity 0.67 [0.35-0.88] vs. 0.22 [0.06-0.55], p = 0.125.

unlisted_practices: Testing whether an on-screen CAD overlay alters multimodal LLM performance on endoscopy video

screen.reason: Empirical pilot study assessing the capability of a multimodal LLM (Gemini 2.5 Pro) to generate clinical reports from endoscopy videos and evaluating the impact of on-screen CAD overlays on its performance.
